# StellR IT LLC

> StellR IT LLC is an AI development and custom software engineering company headquartered in Garland, Texas, USA. We design and engineer custom AI applications, autonomous AI agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) chatbots, SaaS platforms, custom web and mobile applications, and provide dedicated remote software engineering teams for businesses across the United States and internationally.

## Company Entity
- Legal Name: StellR IT LLC
- Official Website: https://www.stellrit.com/
- Headquarters: 5305 Creek CT, Garland, TX 75043, United States
- Direct Phone: +1 (214) 838-0543
- Toll-Free Phone: +1 (325) 480-8108
- Email: info@stellrit.com
- Service Area: Garland, Dallas-Fort Worth, Texas, United States, and international remote delivery

## Services
- [AI Software Development](https://www.stellrit.com/services/ai-software-development): Custom generative AI applications, LLM integrations, predictive systems, and secure enterprise AI engineering.
- [AI Automation & Autonomous AI Agents](https://www.stellrit.com/services/ai-automation-agents): Multi-step autonomous AI agents, workflow automation, CRM/ERP orchestration, and customer support automation.
- [Custom AI Chatbot & RAG Development](https://www.stellrit.com/services/ai-chatbot-development): Enterprise RAG chatbots, vector search pipelines, LLM integrations, and omnichannel conversational AI.
- [Custom Web & Software Development](https://www.stellrit.com/services/web-development): Full-stack web applications, Next.js/React/TypeScript platforms, headless commerce, APIs, and cloud infrastructure.
- [SaaS Development](https://www.stellrit.com/services/saas-development): Multi-tenant SaaS architecture, MVP-to-enterprise product engineering, billing, RBAC, and DevOps.
- [Mobile App Development](https://www.stellrit.com/services/mobile-app-development): iOS, Android, React Native, and Flutter mobile application engineering.
- [Dedicated Engineering Teams](https://www.stellrit.com/services/dedicated-teams): Dedicated AI engineers, full-stack developers, designers, QA, and staff augmentation for agencies and enterprises.
- [UX Research & Strategy](https://www.stellrit.com/services/ux-research-strategy): User research, information architecture, prototyping, and usability testing.
- [Web & Product Design](https://www.stellrit.com/services/web-product-design): Design systems, SaaS UI design, and conversion-focused product interfaces.
- [Brand Identity Design](https://www.stellrit.com/services/brand-identity): Visual identity systems, brand architecture, and guidelines.
- [Digital Marketing, SEO & CRO](https://www.stellrit.com/services/digital-marketing): Technical SEO, search engine marketing, analytics, and conversion rate optimization.
